info.name: HRMS Portal API
info.description:
REST API for the HRMS Portal (NestJS). Generated from the live OpenAPI spec and the controller source by `apps/api/scripts/postman/build-postman.mjs` — regenerate rather than hand-edit.

## Setup
1. Import this collection and one of the environments (**HRMS · Local · Company user** or **HRMS · Local · Super Admin**).
2. In the environment, set `baseUrl` (default `http://localhost:4000`), `email` and `password` (and `companySlug` for company users). Use the **Current value** column so credentials stay on your machine.
3. Select the environment and send any request. A collection pre-request script signs in automatically and refreshes the token when it expires (15 min). You can also run **Authentication → Login** by hand.

## Conventions
- **Base path:** every route is under `/api/v1` except `/health` and `/health/ready`.
- **Auth:** `Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}` (set at collection level). Public endpoints override it with *No Auth*.
- **Two portals:** `portal: "platform"` = Super Admins only; `portal: "company"` (+ `companySlug`) = company users only. Company data is always scoped to the caller's company — another company's ids return **404**, not 403.
- **Requests** are camelCase JSON. **Responses** are snake_case, wrapped as `{ "data": …, "meta": { "request_id": … } }`; lists add paging info to `meta`.
- **Paging:** list endpoints take `page` (1-based) and `limit` (max usually 100–200).
- **Errors** are RFC 7807 `application/problem+json`: `{ type, title, status, detail, instance }` (+ `errors` for validation).
- **Access:** each request's description lists the permission (e.g. `leave.approve`) and/or company feature it needs. Missing permission → 403.
- **Uploads** use `multipart/form-data`; pick the file in the Body tab.
- **Path ids** are left blank — copy an `id` from a list response into the Params tab. Body samples use `00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000` where an id is needed.
- **Live updates** (WebSocket, Socket.IO) are not part of this collection — see `docs/realtime.md`.
- **Swagger UI:** `{{baseUrl}}/api/docs` (non-production only).

exec: // Signs in automatically when accessToken is missing or about to expire,
// using email / password / portal / companySlug from the active environment.
if (!email || !password) return; // nothing to sign in with: send as-is
if (err || res.code !== 200) { console.warn('Auto-login failed', err || res.code); return; }

item.name: Authentication
item.description:
Sign in, sign out, password reset, email verification and session management. Start with **Login** — it stores `accessToken` for every other request.

AuthController — /auth/* endpoints POST /auth/login          Public — email + password → access token (+ refresh cookie) POST /auth/refresh        Public — rotate the refresh cookie → new access token POST /auth/logout         Public — revoke the refresh cookie's session The refresh token only ever travels in an httpOnly cookie (refresh-cookie.ts), never in a response body, so page scripts can't read it. GET  /auth/me             Protected — current user info

request.description:
Requires the current password. All other sessions are signed out; this one stays.

**Access:** any signed-in user (results are scoped to the caller)

**Body fields:**
- `current_password` **(required)** — string
- `new_password` **(required)** — string
- `sign_out_others` — Sign out the other devices (default true); boolean

**Rate limited:** stricter per-IP limit than other endpoints.

_Source: `apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.controller.ts:217` (AuthController.changePassword)_

Sends a reset link to the provided email. Always returns 200 to prevent email enumeration attacks — even if the email does not exist.

**Access:** public — no token needed.

**Body fields:**
- `email` **(required)** — string (email)

**Rate limited:** stricter per-IP limit than other endpoints.

_Source: `apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.controller.ts:157` (AuthController.forgotPassword)_

Returns an access token (15 min); the refresh token (7 days) is set as an httpOnly cookie. Account is locked for 15 minutes after 5 consecutive failures.

**Access:** public — no token needed.

**Body fields:**
- `email` **(required)** — string (email)
- `password` **(required)** — string, length 1–…
- `portal` — Sign-in page used. platform = Super Admins only; company = company users only.; one of: `platform`, `company`
- `companySlug` — Company workspace (company portal only); string, length 0–100, pattern `/^[a-z0-9-]+$/`

**Rate limited:** stricter per-IP limit than other endpoints.

_Source: `apps/api/src/modules/auth/auth.controller.ts:62` (AuthController.login)_

For a Super Admin, use `"portal": "platform"` and drop `companySlug`.

item.name: Update logged-in user preferences (e.g. theme toggle)

request.description:
Update logged-in user preferences (e.g. theme toggle)

**Access:** any signed-in user (results are scoped to the caller)

**Body fields:**
- `theme` — one of: `light`, `dark`, `system`
- `timezone` — string
- `dateFormat` — string
- `notificationsEnabled` — boolean
- `emailNotifications` — boolean
- `notificationTopics` — { time: { app: true, email: false }, … } (merged into the saved choices); object
- `quietHours` — object
- `dailySummary` — boolean
- `density` — Spacing of the interface; "theme" follows the company/platform theme; one of: `theme`, `compact`, `normal`, `spacious`
